as_told.title: Doty doubled down on the L9 story on a podcast with Mario

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who says he and fellow airmen were taken by aliens decades ago, says he later went on a podcast with Richard Doty, a man who has told his own version of what happened to Woods. Woods says Doty was so protected by the podcast's hosts that he could not get a straight answer from any of them. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells it a little differently: he says Doty doubled down on his story of the event, known as the L9 incident. It matters because Woods wants the truth about what happened to him.
